name: sparx — Pressure Washing (Commercial)
tagline: A professional, contract-ready template for commercial exterior cleaning — book consultations from day one.
description: A professional commercial exterior-cleaning site — a deep slate palette with a sharp amber accent, built around online booking. Property managers book a free site assessment, quote or service consultation in about a minute; three crew leads carry their own skills and hours as dispatchable resources. Leads with insured, scheduled service contracts from storefronts to fleets. Ships as "ProWash Exterior Cleaning", a commercial pressure-washing company.
